Potential impact: Applicant data may be exposed through excessive access or retention
Mitigation / safeguard: Data minimisation, role-based access and retention review

Potential impact: Unequal error rates or proxy variables may disadvantage groups
Mitigation / safeguard: Representative evaluation, subgroup monitoring and escalation

Potential impact: Omissions or fabricated details may distort candidate assessment
Mitigation / safeguard: Source-linked summaries and mandatory recruiter verification

Potential impact: Applicants may not understand they are interacting with AI
Mitigation / safeguard: Clear AI disclosure and human escalation channel

Potential impact: Small cohorts may reveal individual information
Mitigation / safeguard: Aggregation thresholds and restricted report access

Potential impact: Malicious files may manipulate extraction or downstream prompts
Mitigation / safeguard: File validation, isolation and adversarial testing

Potential impact: Automation bias may weaken independent human judgement
Mitigation / safeguard: Documented review, override authority and reviewer training

Potential impact: Unclear responsibility may delay remediation of harmful outcomes
Mitigation / safeguard: Named accountability, escalation and supplier responsibilities
